cards.text: Zechariah, a prophet, is in the middle of a run of night visions from the LORD (Zechariah 1:8). Then the prophet says, 'Then I lifted up my eyes and saw a man with a measuring line in his hand.' Friend, that's the look of a man about to tell you your new oven won't fit through the door.

cards.question: Zechariah asks the man with the measuring line where he's going. What is he heading out to measure?

cards.text: Then the angel who's been talking with Zechariah heads out, and another angel comes forward to meet him.

cards.question: Then comes a message to run and tell that young man about Jerusalem. What kind of city will Jerusalem be?

answers.text: A city high on a hill

cards.question: Jerusalem will have no walls because its enemies will keep tearing them down.

cards.text: No walls, because the city will be too FULL of people and livestock. That's a cookie box so packed the lid just gives up and sits on top like a hat.

cards.question: With no walls around Jerusalem, the LORD says He Himself will be something around it. What will He be?
The LORD also says He will be the glory within Jerusalem.

cards.text: Now the LORD calls out to His people who are far from home. He says He's the one who scattered them, like the four winds of heaven.

cards.question: After scattering His people, the LORD tells them to stay where they are in the land of the north.

cards.text: And the call keeps coming: 'Get up, O Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the Daughter of Babylon!'
Then comes a message from the LORD of Hosts, and the one speaking talks about being sent by His Glory against the nations that plundered God's people. Uh oh, somebody's about to get a visit.

cards.question: The LORD of Hosts says whoever touches His people touches something. What do they touch?

cards.text: Then the one speaking says He will surely wave His hand over those nations.

cards.question: The one speaking says He will wave His hand over the nations that plundered God's people. What happens to those nations?

answers.text: Their kings make peace with Zion
Their armies are sent back home

cards.question: When the nations that plundered God's people become plunder themselves, God's people will know the LORD of Hosts sent the one bringing this message.

cards.text: Now the mood FLIPS, and the LORD tells the Daughter of Zion to shout for joy and be glad. Friend, after all that scattering talk, that's the kind of news you read twice just to make sure your eyes still work.

cards.question: Why does the LORD tell the Daughter of Zion to shout for joy?

answers.text: He is coming to dwell among them
Their new walls are finally finished
Their enemies are begging for peace

cards.question: On that day, many nations will join themselves to the LORD, and He says they will become His ___.

cards.text: Then the LORD will take Judah as His portion in the Holy Land, and He will once again choose Jerusalem. Chosen AGAIN, friend, and in the junk drawer I spent years in, the only thing anybody ever picked was the scissors.

cards.question: With the LORD roused from His holy dwelling, all people are told to be silent before Him.

cards.text: And that's where this vision lands. But hold on, friend, Zechariah's not done seeing things yet.
